title: An Eagle Can Spot a Rabbit From Over a Mile Away

scenes.text: An eagle can spot a rabbit moving from over a mile away.
Its eye packs about a million vision cells per square millimeter.
Yours has about two hundred thousand.
An eagle reads at twenty feet what you'd need to be five feet from.
Some reports say it can spot prey two miles away.
A mile away, and it still sees the rabbit move.

description:
An eagle can spot a rabbit moving from over a mile away.
Golden eagles have a retina packed with vision cells, with eyesight estimated at 4 to 8 times that of a human.
Would you want eagle vision for a day?
thumbnail_text: EAGLE SEES A RABBIT FROM A MILE AWAY
first_comment: Bonus: an eagle sees at 20 feet what you need to be 5 feet from to see. What would you look at first?
